metadata.engine: Short-Form Video Script & Retention Engine v2.4

scripts.title: Stop Wasting Your First 3 Seconds (Pattern Interrupt)

beats.visual_cue: Medium close-up. Talent stares intensely at lens, holding empty glass jar upside down. Sudden snap zoom with bold central typography: 'STOP BUANG 60 DETIK LO'.
beats.audio_spoken: 90% video pendek gagal bukan karena visualnya buram, tapi karena scriptnya kelamaan basa-basi di 3 detik awal.
beats.retention_mechanic: Breaks feed scrolling velocity via visual anomaly and immediate provocative accusation.

beats.visual_cue: Fast split screen. Left side: typical talking head video. Right side: real retention analytics curve diving off a cliff at second 3.
beats.audio_spoken: Begitu lo buka dengan kalimat 'Hai guys balik lagi sama gue', 70 persen jempol penonton udah geser ke video orang lain.
beats.retention_mechanic: Visualizes concrete loss aversion; validates the viewer's unconscious behavior.

beats.visual_cue: Rapid cut to overhead desk angle. Hand circles a red countdown timer showing 4.0s. High-contrast typography: 'ATURAN 4 DETIK'.
beats.audio_spoken: Rahasianya ada di aturan 4 detik. Otak manusia di mobile feed butuh kejutan visual baru setiap 4 detik sebelum dopaminnya turun.
beats.retention_mechanic: Resets viewer attention right at the classic 20-second drop-off curve.

beats.visual_cue: Three-point graphical stack slides in synchronously with voice rhythm: 1. Action Hook, 2. Contrarian Data, 3. Micro-Payoff.
beats.audio_spoken: Bagi naskah lo jadi dua kolom: apa yang didengar talent, dan apa yang dilihat editor. Jangan biarkan talent ngomong tanpa ada B-roll pendukung atau teks penegas di layar.
beats.retention_mechanic: High-density actionable insight prevents cognitive fatigue.

beats.visual_cue: Full-screen clean AV script table preview showing color-coded columns for talent and editor.
beats.audio_spoken: Dengan format ini, video 60 detik lo bukan cuma ditonton sampai tuntas, tapi memandu editor motong klip dengan presisi frame.
beats.retention_mechanic: Delivers the promised payoff; establishes authority and professional competence.

beats.visual_cue: Talent points down. Subtle prompt sticker appears: 'Simpan buat syuting besok'. Quick snap back to opening frame.
beats.audio_spoken: Simpan video ini buat acuan syuting lo besok, karena...
beats.retention_mechanic: Incomplete sentence seamlessly chains back into the opening hook, driving >100% completion rate.

beats.visual_cue: Talent holding a stopwatch counting down rapidly from 60 to 0. Big red text: 'MAKSIMAL 140 KATA'.
beats.audio_spoken: Kalau script 60 detik lo lebih dari 150 kata, gue jamin video lo bakal gagal di editing.
beats.retention_mechanic: Unambiguous numerical boundary creates instant curiosity.

beats.visual_cue: Video playback speed fast-forwarded to 1.5x showing comic distorted face and unintelligible robotic audio.
beats.audio_spoken: Banyak scriptwriter nulis kayak nulis artikel blog. Akhirnya talent terpaksa ngomong kayak dikejar kereta dan editor bingung mau taruh B-roll di mana.
beats.retention_mechanic: Humorous relatable pain point relieves cognitive fatigue.

beats.visual_cue: Animated audio waveform visualizer showing healthy pause pockets between words.
beats.audio_spoken: Tempo bicara natural bahasa Indonesia itu 140 kata per menit. Lo butuh jeda 0.5 detik buat nafas, sound effect, dan transisi layar.
beats.retention_mechanic: Grounded mathematical metric provides undeniable clarity.

beats.visual_cue: Side-by-side comparison of cluttered prose paragraph vs streamlined 2-column AV table.
beats.audio_spoken: Gunakan struktur 3-layer: baris dialog pendek, kolom visual cue buat panduan editor, dan catatan emosi talent. Satu kalimat, satu ide tunggal.
beats.retention_mechanic: Strunk Elements of Style applied to short video delivery.

beats.visual_cue: Stopwatch stops exactly at 00:60.00. Talent smiles and taps screen.
beats.audio_spoken: Terapkan aturan 140 kata ini di draf naskah berikutnya, dan tonton retensi video lo melonjak dua kali lipat.
beats.retention_mechanic: Definitive outcome expectation paired with positive reinforcement.
